rule: p = 0.5 * p_B1 + 0.5 * p_CNN per image, prediction = argmax; no weight, threshold or temperature is fitted

members.B1: tools.compare_tabular.run_loso('B1', 20261006, 'reference', R2 cap, group-guarded inner temperature); deterministic, so the same B1 probabilities are paired with every CNN seed

all_reported: every ensemble listed here is reported; none is dropped or selected
gate_before_ensembling: B1 fixed-protocol refit must reproduce mean LOSO macro-F1 0.6381973706626417 within 1e-12; otherwise stop
population: the 3395 trainval images of tools.train_baseline.load_rows; split=test never read
metric: tools.summarize_runs.evaluate (fold_table + calibration); primary = mean LOSO macro-F1, mean +- std(ddof=1) over the 3 CNN seeds

decision_rule.wins_if: mean LOSO macro-F1 (mean over 3 seeds) > B1

post_hoc_disclosure: this idea was proposed after the holdout results of both members were seen (CNN ahead of B1 on rf_robusta only). The rule itself has no tunable part, but the decision to try it used holdout information, so a win here would be a hypothesis to confirm on new data, not a deploy decision by itself.
diagnostics: per fold: share of images where exactly one member is right, and the 'either member right' upper bound; descriptive only
limits: LOSO source-level convenience dataset; no Pi/E2E/frozen-test claim; inner groups and manifest are the regenerated copies documented in the CNN run plan
